identity.description: An attacker uses schtasks to create a scheduled task that executes a malicious binary with SYSTEM privileges. Cortex should detect the execution of a process with high integrity level (SYSTEM) that was initiated by a scheduled task.

expected_artifacts.description: Malicious binary created in temp directory

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Suspicious Process Executed with High Integrity Level
biocs.description: A process was started with SYSTEM integrity level that was initiated by a scheduled task
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\schtasks.exe'
| filter action_process_integrity_level = ENUM.HIGH
